title: Ding Talapagawa da ring Matas a Asias
intro: Makatalakad ka arapan da ring lasak ning metung a marangal a minunang siudad, ding matas nang asias ngeni mebaldug la. Ing angin gugulisak ya kareng dalan a alang tau, magdalang alaala ning metung a mayupayang balen a minunang mig-ari kareng gabun a reni. Ninu ila?
clues: Metung kaming balen a ating maragul a sikanan ampo kabiasnan, a kilala kareng kekaming mangaragul a gusali ampo matas a sibilisasyun.
manuknangan kami keng gabun a ating balas ampo bunduk a mabatu, ampo maniwala kami na alang makayabut kekami.
Metung a tubud ing dinatang kekami ibat kareng kekaming kamaganak, inaus na kami ban samban mi ya mu i Allah, dapot tinanggi mi ya at linawe mi ya.
Pigmaragul mi, Ninu ing maygit kekami? at sindu mi ing kekaming kayabangan at pamanyamba karing idolo.
Ing Allah peparala na kekatamu ing masikan a angin a tiniup kilub ning pitung bengi at walung aldo, a mekasira king sabla.
Ikami ding memalen na ning 'Ad, ding menalakad king Iram, at ing kapalaran mi meging babala ya karing sablang tinuki kaybat na nita.

location.label: Nanu ing lagyu ning karelang maalamat a balen?

outcome.label: Nanu ing karelang kapalaran?
options: Mesira la at ding karelang mitagan meging aral la
outcome.answer: Mesira la at ding karelang mitagan meging aral la

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
